findings.message: The mesaForm organism submits createMesa and updateMesa but no command.input state was defined; added the minimum shared mesaFormDraft state and setMesaForm setter.
The mesaId selection had no function that writes the selected record; added selectMesa(id) with null clearing and list-row resolution.
public mesaFormDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selectMesa is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setMesaForm is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
